_comment: Value-lenses — the internal engine for steel-man and red-team. NOT party personas (party framing imports tribal bias and slides into caricature). The UI MAY present these as 'the case from the left / right' but that is a presentation layer only. See spec §2.

lenses.name: Market / efficiency
lenses.concerns: efficiency, growth, incentives, competition, supply response

lenses.name: Equity / distribution
lenses.concerns: distribution, fairness, who bears the cost, the worst-off

lenses.name: Fiscal sustainability
lenses.concerns: cost to the Exchequer, debt, value-for-money, revenue certainty

lenses.name: Delivery / implementation
lenses.concerns: capacity, timelines, deliverability, unintended effects, gaming
